title: SRE shift journal — snapshot 2026-07-15
content:
Snapshot for SRE shift covering 2026-07-14 22:00 UTC -> 2026-07-15 10:00 UTC.

Summary:
- No Sev1 outages. Two Sev2-class incidents and one Sev3 during the window.
- Main theme: transient KV-cache eviction behavior under hot-prefix patterns causing tail-latency spikes on text-generation endpoints and a secondary disturbance in model routing that increased token spend for a subset of requests.
- Actionables captured for follow-up: KV cache metrics dashboard drift, routing-fallback backpressure tuning, and a resiliency test for regional disk pressure handling.

Incident INC-2026-072 (Sev2) — KV-cache thrash (primary incident):
- Timeline: 2026-07-15 00:12 UTC: first latency alerts for api/text-gen-core; 00:18 UTC: error rate climbed to 0.9% for 95th/99th; mitigated by rolling restart of inference pool nodes in us-west-2 at 00:34 UTC.
- Impact: Increased 99p latency from ~120ms -> ~420ms for ~22 minutes for customers on shared-hosted tier. A small fraction (~0.4%) of requests were retried by the SDK leading to duplicated charge events.
- Root cause hypothesis: interplay between recent KV cache eviction policy change (LRU window shrink deployed in serving-runtime PR#987) and a hot-prefix workload from a customer test traffic pattern. Frequent cache evictions amplified I/O and KV lookup contention.
- Mitigation timeline: rolled restart, temporarily widened LRU window (hotfix config), and enabled prefix-level sampling to reduce thrash. Latencies returned to baseline by 00:50 UTC.
- Owners: Marco Diaz (lead responder), Aisha Patel (handoff), follow-up owner: Marco Diaz (investigation).
- Follow-ups: create deterministic load test for hot-prefix patterns, add a SLO-aligned alert for cache eviction rate delta, revert/pin LRU window change pending root cause verification. Tracking ticket: SRE-4231.

Incident INC-2026-073 (Sev2) — Model routing fallback cascade:
- Timeline: 2026-07-15 02:05 UTC: smart-router started returning fallback-variant routes for 12% of requests to reduce latency; 02:12 UTC: fallback saturation led to higher token counts as fallback model used longer context and different sampling settings, visible in billing anomaly alerts; 02:30 UTC: throttled fallback pool and rolled minor config rollback at 02:42 UTC.
- Impact: Cost spike for affected customers (early estimate +6% token consumption across the window) and small increase in user-perceived variability of completions quality.
- Root cause: routing policy's fallback ramp logic didn't correctly account for fallback model's expected token-per-response multiplier. Policy thresholds were tuned for latency but not cost.
- Mitigation: rolled back fallback ramp thresholds, applied emergency routing cap to keep fallback assignment <4% while rollback is validated.
- Owners: Lena Thompson (routing), follow-up owner: Product + Applied ML to verify model cost profiles.
- Follow-ups: add cost-multiplier into routing policy evaluation, tie to Optimize recommendations; Jira: SRE-4232 and product ticket PROD-1187.

Incident INC-2026-074 (Sev3) — eu-nrt disk pressure affecting orchestrator pods:
- Timeline: 2026-07-15 06:20 UTC: kubelet eviction events recorded on a small set of control-plane nodes in eu-nrt; 06:45 UTC: pods restarted, autoscaler temporarily overshot until node stabilization at 07:05 UTC.
- Impact: short-lived 503s for internal monitoring agents and delayed tracing uploads. No customer-facing errors observed due to redundancy.
- Mitigation: cleared ephemeral volumes on affected nodes, adjusted cluster storage watermark thresholds to delay eviction, and retagged nodes for future maintenance.
- Owners: SRE on-call (shift), follow-up owner: infra team.
- Follow-ups: scheduled rolling maintenance for eu-nrt control-plane 2026-07-22; add automated cleanup cron to avoid ephemeral volume accumulation.

SLO / Metrics snapshot (last 7 days, rolling):
- text-gen endpoints availability: 99.98% (monthly target 99.95%) — error budget remaining: 88%
- chat endpoints availability: 99.94% (monthly target 99.9%) — error budget remaining: 72%
- median latency (text-gen): 92ms (baseline 95ms)
- 99th latency spike events (>300ms): 4 events in 7 days (two correlated with KV-cache thrash patterns)
- Cost anomaly: detected +6% token spend during 02:00–03:00 UTC window (investigating correlation with routing fallback).

On-call handoff / outstanding items:
- Outgoing on-call: Aisha Patel. Incoming on-call: Kofi Mensah (start 2026-07-15 10:00 UTC).
- Outstanding action items:
  - Marco: finish deterministic hot-prefix load test and link results to SRE-4231 (ETA 2026-07-18).
  - Lena + Applied ML: publish model cost multipliers for the fallbacks and create simulation for routing policy (ETA 2026-07-20).
  - Infra: implement ephemeral volume cleanup cron for eu-nrt (ETA 2026-07-19).
  - Monitoring: add eviction-rate anomaly alert and cache-eviction-delta dashboard panels (owner: SRE monitoring, ETA 2026-07-17).
- Notes for incoming on-call: watch for elevated cache_eviction_rate and routing.fallback_rate metrics. If cache_eviction_rate > baseline * 3 for >10m, enforce temporary LRU-window widen and trigger hot-prefix sampling. Reference playbooks: confluence SRE cache playbook and routing fallback runbook.

Operational items / upcoming maintenance:
- Planned: eu-nrt control-plane rolling maintenance 2026-07-22 02:00–04:00 UTC (ETA: 2 hours). Communication to customers scheduled for 2026-07-19.
- Canary: deploy updated batching kernel with conservative TTL changes to 5% of serving pool on 2026-07-18. Watch 99p latency and cache eviction metrics.
- Experiment: enable finer-grained prefix sampling in staging to simulate hot-client workloads.

Notes / Miscellaneous:
- Billing note: finance alerted of potential duplicated charges from SDK retry behavior during INC-2026-072; customer-success loop has been opened to reach affected customers.
- Documentation: update "cache tuning" section in ops runbook with new LRU-window knobs and emergency widen steps (owner: Marco).

Postmortem plan:
- INC-2026-072: full postmortem due 2026-07-21 (SRE-4231). Include load-test provenance, PR#987 review, and roll-forward plan.
- INC-2026-073: coordinated owner meeting with Product & Applied ML on 2026-07-19 (SRE-4232).

If any of the incoming on-call needs a quick sync before handoff, ping #sre-ops; otherwise next formal notes will be the weekly SRE roundup.

-- Aisha (outgoing shift)
